items.source: If not set, the default consistency set in AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration.getDefaultConsistency() is used.
items.translation: 如果未设置，则使用AbstractCouchbaseConfiguration.getDefaultConsistency()中定义的默认一致性。

items.source:
Annotation to set the scan consistency of N1QL queries with Couchbase. This controls whether couchbase waits for all
changes to be processed by an index or whether stale results are acceptable.
items.translation: 注释用于设置 N1QL 查询的扫描一致性，以控制 Couchbase 是等待所有更改由索引处理完毕，还是接受陈旧结果。
